title: Apply to register a personally imported vehicle
summary: This page outlines the process for applying to register a personally imported vehicle after it has cleared customs.
intro:
When your personally imported vehicle has cleared customs, you need to drive it directly to a weighbridge (if it's a make and model not normally available in Australia), and/or an Authorised Unregistered Vehicle Inspection Scheme (AUVIS) station.

Registration is exempt on this journey, as long as you don't break the journey, or take the vehicle home (unless it's being transported on a trailer).

The AUVIS examiner will:

Depending on the type of import approval you obtained, you may be required to attach an import plate to the vehicle. If so, attach it in accordance with the instructions supplied.

The vehicle then needs to be re-inspected at the AUVIS station, before you can apply to register it.
who_can_apply: The vehicle must be personally imported and have cleared customs.
The vehicle must be re-inspected at the AUVIS station before registration can be applied for.
what_you_need: Proof of entitlement to register the vehicle (bill of sale or overseas registration certificate, if applicable)
Compulsory third party (CTP) insurance receipt (green slip) with the number plate section left blank (except for trailers and caravans)
Vehicle Safety Compliance Certification Scheme (VSCCS) compliance certificate (if applicable)
Vehicle Identity & Inspections Unit (VIIU) report (if applicable)
Representative's authority (if being registered in the name of an organisation)

how_to_steps.text: Take the completed form and required documents to a Service NSW Centre and lodge your application.

faqs.q: What happens after my personally imported vehicle clears customs?
faqs.a: You must drive the vehicle directly to a weighbridge (if it is a make and model not normally available in Australia) and/or an Authorised Unregistered Vehicle Inspection Scheme (AUVIS) station. Registration is exempt during this journey, provided you do not break the journey or take the vehicle home (unless it is being transported on a trailer).

faqs.q: What is required before I can apply to register the vehicle?
faqs.a: The vehicle must be re-inspected at the AUVIS station before you can apply to register it.

faqs.q: Where do I lodge my application?
faqs.a: Take the completed form and required documents to a Service NSW Centre.
